name: Seremban
pointBasis: Immutable WUP 2025 city coordinate, copied without adjustment; latitude/longitude order preserved.
registryBasis: Official Pejabat Daerah dan Tanah Seremban material identifies the local land office as the place for land-registration status and cadastral-plan procedures; official JUPEM Negeri Sembilan material identifies the state survey/mapping office. This evidences custodianship and procedure, not owner or title data.
blocker: A safe anonymous public polygon response is verified, but runtime adapter admission remains held for independent serial review.

source.name: Negeri Sembilan Government Geoformatik ArcGIS service / JUPEM Lot Kadaster
source.operator: Negeri Sembilan government Geoformatik service; layer copyright/source states JUPEM, 2020
source.nativeIdField: UPI; FID also exposed as object identifier
source.operatorNote: Only safe public parcel identity, geometry, CRS, and non-sensitive schema metadata retained. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields requested or retained.
source.nativeIdEvidence: Layer schema exposes UPI (16-character parcel identity), MUKIM, PA, LOT, and FID. Retained GeoJSON uses UPI only as canonical id.
source.retainedAttributePolicy: GeoJSON properties reduced to {id: UPI}; source field names and mapping are documented here and in the service review.
source.compositeKeyProvenance: UPI is a native field returned by the service and is retained as the stable identity; PA, LOT, and MUKIM are supporting native fields only and are not retained in GeoJSON properties.

verifiedParcelResponse.query: where=FID IN (0,1,2), outFields=FID,MUKIM,PA,LOT,UPI,KELUASAN, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, f=geojson

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Negeri Sembilan government ArcGIS service and official Seremban/JUPEM land-office pages were reviewed.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The service exposes a Negeri Sembilan Lot Kadaster polygon layer and returned three safe parcel geometries; this is not proof of complete Seremban or statewide coverage.

technicalBlocker: The service is reachable with ordinary anonymous HTTP requests. HTTPS certificate verification failed in the local curl environment for this host; no TLS verification bypass was used. The exact WUP point was not shifted and was not used to infer absence.
remainingUncertainty: The retained polygons are bounded schema/geometry evidence, not a citywide completeness sample; current service freshness and coverage within the Seremban municipal extent require serial review.
